title: Admin panel: edit form, publish/unpublish controls, Next.js draft mode preview, and redirect manager
description: Build the edit guide form (/admin/guides/[id]/edit) with pre-filled fields and status workflow buttons. Admin-only publish/unpublish with confirmation dialogs. Preview via Next.js draft mode API route (/api/preview and /api/preview-exit). Slug change on published guide triggers confirmation and auto-creates redirect. Redirect manager UI (/admin/guides/redirects). Validation source of truth: testplan.md A07–A10.

proof.notes: A07-A10 implemented with repo-backed proof: publish is blocked without bilingual H1 in convex/guides/mutations.ts and the edit UI in src/components/admin/guides/GuideEditView.tsx; draft preview now flows through src/app/api/preview/route.ts plus draft-aware rendering in src/app/(public)/guides/[slug]/page.tsx and src/lib/guides/content.ts, with exit via src/app/api/preview-exit/route.ts; published slug changes are gated by a confirmation dialog in src/components/admin/guides/GuideEditView.tsx and create 301 redirects with auto-created reason in convex/guides/mutations.ts; redirect manager is live at src/app/(dashboard)/admin/guides/redirects/page.tsx using src/components/admin/guides/GuideRedirectsView.tsx plus add/delete redirect mutations in convex/guides/mutations.ts.
